releaseNotes:
- The panel readout only reads, it never sets anything on the panel
- Send to VR: Try again on a failed transfer, and the earlier job moves into Archive
- The panel readout tries 2x2 itself when the panel will not list its modes, and checks the panel is back at 1x1
- The panel readout says what the panel answered, not only what it gave
- An annotation keeps its size relative to the image it is drawn on
- An annotation on an exported image comes through whole
- Read what the panel can actually do, instead of assuming it
- Leave the headset folder alone, and stop waiting for a name
